id: 401-亞拉里克一世第一次入侵意大利

battle.name: 亞拉里克一世第一次入侵意大利
battle.brief: 西哥特王亞拉里克於401年越過東阿爾卑斯山侵入義大利，圍亞奎萊亞後轉戰波倫提亞。攝政斯提里科調集野戰軍與盟邦援軍北上，402年復活節夜破敵於波倫提亞，六月再勝於維羅納河畔。西哥特前線步兵多出自羅馬軍營，以盾牆方陣作戰，終究輸於糧道與攻城器械。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 這場衝突是西羅馬帝國與西哥特聯軍之間的第一次全面野戰，交戰地在義大利北部。羅馬一方名義上歸皇帝霍諾留斯管轄，實際的軍政大權握在西羅馬攝政、magister militum 斯提里科手上；他調集了禁衛軍團（scholae palatinae）、從義大利各城市徵召的民兵，以及大批與帝國結盟的外族同盟軍（foederati），其中包含巴達維亞人等外族騎兵，以及從不列顛與萊茵調回的野戰軍。西哥特一方則是亞拉里克率領的哥特戰士團，核心是多瑙河下游的哥特人，但隊伍裡混有大量羅馬逃兵與脫役者，以及被征服後編入的部族戰士。亞拉里克早在397年已被東方朝廷任命為伊利里亞的軍事長官（magister militum per Illyricum），以鎮壓當地部族並領取年金，因此這支部隊在體制上仍是羅馬的同盟者，只是不再接受羅馬的節制。東羅馬皇帝阿卡狄烏斯把西哥特人當作對付兄長霍諾留斯的棋子，這一點讓西部的外交處境格外緊張。整場戰爭沒有任何一方具備攻城器械，決戰只能發生在開闊的波河平原上。
countriesEn: This clash was the first full-scale field battle between the Western Roman Empire and the Visigothic confederacy, and it was fought in northern Italy. On the Roman side the campaign belonged nominally to the emperor Honorius, but the real military and political authority rested with Stilicho, the magister militum who governed the West; he drew on the scholae palatinae, on the militia levies of the Italian cities, and on large contingents of barbarian foederati bound to the empire, among them Batavians and other barbarian riders, together with field troops recalled from Britain and the Rhine. Alaric's side was the Gothic war-band he led: at its core men from the lower Danube, but the ranks were also filled with Roman deserters and runaways, together with warriors conscripted from conquered tribes. Alaric had already been appointed magister militum per Illyricum by the eastern court in 397, charged with suppressing the local tribes and drawing a pension; in institutional terms his force was still a Roman ally, only one no longer taking orders from Rome. The eastern emperor Arcadius treated the Visigoths as a piece to be used against his brother Honorius, which made the western diplomatic position still more precarious. Neither side fielded siege artillery, so the decision had to be reached in the open ground of the Po valley.
people: 關鍵人物集中在四方。亞拉里克一世約生於370年，多瑙河三角洲的一座小島上；394年他已以羅馬同盟軍首領的身分在弗里吉斯河畔打過一仗，395年狄奧多西一世死後被哥特部眾推舉為王，此後他在東西兩朝之間以羅馬邊境將軍的名義遊走，401年終於自己決定向意大利進軍。斯提里科是西羅馬的實際執政者，狄奧多西一世之妹塞雷娜的丈夫，其女瑪莉亞又於398年嫁與霍諾留斯，因此與皇帝有翁婿之誼；皇帝本人卻幾無實權，因此與亞拉里克的所有談判都由他出面。皇帝霍諾留斯自幼養在宮中，既無戰陣經驗，也少有獨立判斷，只能在軍報與請願之間往返。東方的阿卡狄烏斯只是把西哥特人當作一枚棋子，並無能力約束亞拉里克。地方官員之中，伊利里亞總督 Anicius Olybrius 與亞拉里克積怨最深，他屢次向朝廷指控哥特人劫掠，最後被解職逐出伊利里亞，亞拉里克隨即失去合法的棲身之所。史家佐西莫斯記錄了402年兩戰的經過，是今日重建此役的主要依據；同時代詩人克勞狄安則以《哥特戰爭》歌頌斯提里科，把波倫提亞與維羅納寫成攝政的榮光。兩份材料立場相反，需互相參照。斯提里科的幼子尤刻里烏斯在波倫提亞之戰中負傷，參將 Eutychianus 亦在陣中，這說明羅馬方面的指揮核心並未留在安全後方。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities lie in four camps. Alaric I, born around 370 on an island in the Danube delta, was already leading a Roman allied war-band at the River Frigidus in 394; after Theodosius I died in 395 the Goths raised him to kingship, and from then on he moved between the two courts as a Roman frontier general, until in 401 he decided on his own to march into Italy. Stilicho was the de facto ruler of the West, husband of Serena, sister of Theodosius I, and father-in-law of Honorius through his daughter Maria, who married the emperor in 398; the young emperor nevertheless had no real power in his hands, so every negotiation with Alaric was conducted by Stilicho himself. Honorius had been raised in the palace, had no experience of battle and rarely an independent judgement, and could only shuttle between dispatches and petitions. In the east, Arcadius treated the Visigoths as a piece on the board and had no means of restraining Alaric. Among the provincial officials, Anicius Olybrius, governor of Illyricum, held the deepest grudge against Alaric; he accused the Goths of plunder before the court again and again, was finally dismissed and driven out of Illyricum, and Alaric thereby lost his lawful place of refuge. The historian Zosimus recorded the course of the two battles of 402 and is the principal basis for reconstructing the campaign today; the contemporary poet Claudian, in his De Bello Gothico, praised Stilicho and turned Pollentia and Verona into the glory of the regent. The two sources pull in opposite directions and must be read against each other. Stilicho's young son Eucherius was wounded at Pollentia, and his quaestor Eutychianus was present in the line as well, which shows that the Roman command core was not sitting safely behind the fighting line.
kits: 卡面的希臘重步兵（hoplite）是這場戰役最遙遠的技術祖型。公元前五世紀的方陣步兵手持圓盾（aspis）、長矛（dory）、青銅頭盔與亞麻背心（linothorax），以互相遮蔽的盾牆承擔正面衝擊；到公元四世紀末，這種典型編制早已在希臘本土消失，但它留下的「以盾牆取代個人武勇」的原理，經羅馬軍團繼承，再向北滲入晚期羅馬的盾兵（scutarii）與邊軍重裝步兵，最後又被在西羅馬軍中服役過的哥特老兵帶回西哥特陣營。因此401年亞拉里克軍中的重步兵骨架，多是穿羅馬式橢圓大盾（scutum）、持短劍與標槍的資深兵，真正的傳統方陣兵已是少數。雙方都沒有希臘式的密集長矛陣：羅馬邊軍以橢圓盾配短劍（gladius）、標槍與長矛，帝國晚期已放棄分段甲，改用鎖子甲（lorica hamata）與鱗甲，頭盔則是脊盔（Decius 型）；西哥特重裝兵用圓盾或橢圓盾、長矛、雙刃直刀（spatha）與飛矛，鎧甲以鎖子甲和皮條甲為主。遠射方面，西哥特人使用小型複合弓與投石索，羅馬軍則有弓手隊（sagittarii）與殘存的手弩、擲石索。騎兵是雙方共同的機動主力：西哥特人大量使用體型較小的本地馬，羅馬人則以禁衛軍與外族盟軍的騎兵作偵察與追擊。攻城與運輸方面，亞拉里克在亞奎萊亞靠封鎖與迫降取勝，沒有重型攻城塔或撞槌；羅馬西部野戰軍此時也已不再攜帶攻城砲與攻城塔，後勤依靠牛車、馬匹與波河沿岸城市的徵發，這正是西哥特遠征最弱的一環。
kitsEn: The Greek hoplite on the card is the most distant technical ancestor of this campaign. The phalanx infantry of the fifth century BC carried the round aspis, the long dory, a bronze helmet and a linothorax cuirass, and absorbed the frontal impact through a wall of overlapping shields; by the end of the fourth century AD that classic institution had long disappeared from Greece itself, but the principle it left behind — a wall of shields taking the place of individual valour — passed through the Roman legions, spread north into the late Roman scutarii and the heavy infantry of the frontier, and was finally carried back into the Visigothic camp by Gothic veterans who had served in Roman armies. In 401 the heavy infantry core of Alaric's force was therefore mostly veterans carrying the Roman oval scutum with a short sword and javelins, while true phalanx men were already a minority. Neither side fielded a Greek-style massed pike block: Roman frontier troops matched the oval shield with a gladius, javelins and spears, and by the late empire had abandoned the segmented cuirass for chain mail (lorica hamata) and scale, with ridge helmets of the Decius type. The Gothic heavy infantry used round or oval shields, spears, the spatha and throwing spears, with chain and leather armour. At range the Goths used small composite bows and slings, while the Romans had arrow units (sagittarii) and the remaining hand bows and stone-throwers. Cavalry was the shared arm of manoeuvre on both sides: the Goths used a great many small native horses, the Romans relied on the imperial guard and on allied barbarian horse for scouting and pursuit. On siege and transport, Alaric took Aquileia by blockade and starvation and had no heavy siege tower or battering ram; the western Roman field army by this time no longer dragged siege artillery and towers with it, and its logistics ran on ox-carts, horses and requisitions from the cities of the Po valley — which was exactly the weakest link in the Gothic expedition.
tactics: 戰術層面，雙方的差別不在個人武藝，而在誰能把散兵重新編成一條可以承擔撞擊的線。401年秋，亞拉里克率軍翻越朱利安阿爾卑斯山，沿亞奎萊亞方向進入義大利，一度以封鎖方式圍困亞奎萊亞，試圖用急迫的戰局逼西羅馬談判；斯提里科沒有逐城救援，而是把禁衛軍、民兵與同盟軍集中起來北上，避免兵力被拉散，再用道路與波河沿岸城市的徵發維持補給。402年復活節主日當夜及其後一整日，斯提里科選在波倫提亞動手：西哥特人營於坦納羅河與博爾米達河匯流處的高地，營盤以輜重車與壕溝自衛；羅軍在夜裡以同盟軍為先鋒突入營盤，雙方在黑暗中短兵相接，慘烈到火光徹夜，羅軍數次被衝出營地又反覆攻回，幼子尤刻里烏斯在混戰中受傷，戰局最終因西哥特人放棄營盤、退向山林而結束。維羅納一戰最能看出斯提里科的野戰手腕：他把主力配置在阿迪杰河（Athesis）東岸的高地，逼西哥特人離開營地進攻，待其隊形拉開、糧車與輜重落在後方時，羅軍騎兵裝作潰退引誘追擊，隨即以步兵正面反擊，同時由兩翼合圍，最終把哥特人趕入阿迪杰河，許多人溺斃。亞拉里克自此不再戀戰，退回伊利里亞。整體看，羅馬靠的是集中兵力、選戰地、夜襲與假退真攻的組合，而西哥特靠的是突進速度與劫掠補給；勝負之別，就在於誰能把這批善於散兵游鬥的戰士收束成可反覆使用的整體。
tacticsEn: At the level of tactics, the difference between the two sides lay less in individual prowess than in who could re-knit loose men into a line able to absorb an impact. In the autumn of 401 Alaric led his force over the Julian Alps and into Italy along the line of Aquileia, at one point blockading and starving the city in order to force the western court to negotiate; Stilicho did not relieve town by town but concentrated the guard, the militia and the allied federate troops and marched north with them, refusing to let his strength be dispersed, and kept his supplies moving by road and by requisition from the cities of the Po valley. On the night of Easter Sunday in 402, and in the fighting that followed, Stilicho chose to strike at Pollentia: the Goths were encamped on high ground at the confluence of the Tanaro and the Bormida, their camp fenced by baggage waggons and ditches. The Romans entered the camp by night with the federate troops in front, and the two sides fought at close quarters in the dark, so savagely that torches burned until morning; the Romans were driven out of the camp several times and stormed back in each time, the young Eucherius was wounded in the mêlée, and the engagement ended only when the Goths abandoned their position and withdrew into the hills. The battle at Verona shows Stilicho's fieldcraft most clearly: he posted the bulk of his force on high ground east of the river Athesis, forced the Goths to leave their camp to attack, and waited until their order had stretched out and their baggage and grain carts had fallen behind; then Roman cavalry feigned a broken retreat to draw them on, the infantry counter-attacked in front, and the two wings closed in, driving the Goths into the Adige, where many were drowned. Alaric thereupon stopped trying to force a decision and withdrew to Illyria. On the whole, Rome's victory rested on concentrating force, choosing the ground, striking by night and turning a feigned retreat into a real counter-attack, while the Goths relied on speed of advance and on living off the country. The difference in the result came down to who could gather scattered, harrying warriors into a formation that could be used again and again.
data: 可核對的數字不多，必須分清哪些是史料明載、哪些只是推算。時間線最清楚：入侵定於401年秋，史料只記年份不記月份；兩場決戰的日期則相當明確，波倫提亞之戰是402年4月6日，即復活節主日，維羅納之戰在402年6月初。行程上，亞奎萊亞到波倫提亞沿海路與大道約250公里，波倫提亞到維羅納約100公里，兩役之間的推進速度說明西哥特軍並未急於求戰。錢財數字有案可查：亞拉里克在397至398年出任伊利里亞軍事長官時，東方朝廷的讓步通常記作每年四千磅黃金（亦有記載指一次支付四千磅為首期），一磅約327克，四千磅約合1.3噸黃金；408年他再度進軍義大利時向霍諾留斯開價五千磅黃金加四千人質；410年破羅馬後取走的也是五千磅。兵員數字則完全不可靠，佐西莫斯只寫西哥特大軍「不可勝數」，不留人數，近代學者從徵召範圍推估在數萬人量級，但彼此差異極大，不宜當作定數；斯提里科一方同樣沒有留下總兵力，只有禁衛軍、民兵與同盟軍並用的線索。戰地地理是少數可以精確的資料：波倫提亞即今義大利亞歷山德里亞一帶的古城，亞歷山德里亞本身是中世紀後才建起的新城，402年的營盤位於坦納羅河與博爾米達河匯流的台地上；維羅納一戰的河是阿迪杰河，古名 Athesis。
dataEn: Few figures can be checked, and one has to separate what the sources state outright from what is merely inferred. The chronology is the firmest part: the invasion is placed in the autumn of 401, with the sources recording the year but not the month; the dates of the two decisive battles, by contrast, are clear enough — Pollentia was fought on 6 April 402, Easter Sunday, and Verona in the first days of June 402. As for distances, roughly 250 kilometres separate Aquileia from Pollentia along the coastal road and the great highways, and about 100 kilometres separate Pollentia from Verona; the pace of movement between the two engagements shows that the Gothic army was in no hurry to force a result. The money is documented: when Alaric was appointed military governor of Illyricum in 397 or 398, the concession of the eastern court is usually recorded as four thousand pounds of gold a year, though other accounts give it as a single payment of four thousand pounds as the first instalment; a pound being about 327 grams, so four thousand pounds came to roughly 1.3 tonnes of gold; in 408, when he invaded Italy again, he priced his terms at five thousand pounds of gold plus four thousand hostages; and after the capture of Rome in 410 he took away five thousand pounds. Headcounts are simply not reliable — Zosimus writes only that the Gothic host was countless and gives no figure, and modern scholars, inferring from the range of conscription, put it in the tens of thousands with enormous disagreement, so it should not be treated as a fixed number; Stilicho's side left no total either, only the evidence that guard, militia and allied federate troops were used together. The geography of the battlefield is one of the few precisely recoverable data: Pollentia was the ancient town in the region of modern Alessandria, and Alessandria itself is a much later medieval foundation, so the camp of 402 stood on the terrace where the Tanaro and the Bormida meet; the river fought over at Verona was the Adige, ancient Athesis.
cause: 起因為什麼會打成這樣，要從羅馬對邊疆部族的制度說起。晚期羅馬的辦法是「以金錢換和平」：把部族首領編為同盟將領，付年金、劃地安置，讓他們替帝國守住多瑙河一線，用敵人的刀去擋另一批敵人。亞拉里克在397年得到的正是這種位置，條件是留在伊利里亞、替朝廷清剿當地的魯吉人與索利人。這種安排本質上不穩：羅馬朝廷不斷要求同盟軍交還逃兵、繳械、限制徵召，同盟軍的規模又隨首領的野心膨脹，兩邊互信正在耗盡。具體的導火線有三層。其一，朝廷答應給伊利里亞的永久居留地始終沒有落實，亞拉里克只能靠年金支撐一支無法安置的家屬與牲畜；其二，伊利里亞總督 Olybrius 屢次指控並刁難他，使亞拉里克在本地失去立足之地；其三，東方朝廷有意讓他威脅西部，等於默許甚至鼓勵他向西轉進。斯提里科拒絕在義大利境內給哥特人劃地安置，也拒絕交出羅馬逃亡士兵，談判遂無結果。於是亞拉里克帶著整支部隊越過阿爾卑斯山進入義大利，用軍事既成事實去換取他想要的土地與金錢——這正是這場入侵的直接原因。
causeEn: Why this came to blows has to be explained from the Roman system for dealing with frontier peoples. Late Rome's method was to pay for peace: to enrol tribal leaders as allied commanders, pay them a pension, settle them on land, and let them hold the Danube line for the empire, using one barbarian's sword against the next. What Alaric obtained in 397 was exactly such a position, on condition that he stay in Illyricum and clear the Rugians and Soratians for the court. The arrangement was inherently unstable: the Roman government kept demanding the return of deserters, disarmament and limits on recruitment from the allied war-bands, while the size of those bands swelled with their commander's ambition, so trust drained away on both sides. The immediate fuse had three layers. First, the permanent settlement in Illyricum that had been promised was never actually delivered, and Alaric was left supporting a following he could not settle, with families and livestock, on pension alone; second, the governor of Illyricum, Olybrius, accused and obstructed him repeatedly until he was driven out of his own province; third, the eastern court had an interest in letting him threaten the west, and so at least tolerated, indeed encouraged, his turn to the west. Stilicho refused to grant the Goths land inside Italy and refused to hand back the Roman runaway soldiers in their ranks, and the negotiations came to nothing. Alaric then took his entire force over the Alps into Italy, and used accomplished military fact to obtain the land and the gold he wanted — which is the direct cause of this invasion.
impact: 影響遠超出義大利一地的戰場。第一，它把西羅馬的西來風暴推遲了八年。402年的兩場敗仗沒有摧毀亞拉里克，反而證明羅馬無法長期把他擋在亞得里亞海東岸；此後數年西羅馬每年照付年金，靠的是把哥特人當作屏障，這種「付錢買邊防」的制度最終被自己養大的軍隊反噬。第二，斯提里科因這場勝利獲得空前威望與戰利品，於403年受全城歡迎、並在圖拉真廣場立像紀念，卻也因功高震主而在408年被皇帝霍諾留斯處決。斯提里科一死，他麾下的外族同盟軍立即倒向亞拉里克，亞拉里克於是得以在408年與410年兩度進入義大利，終於在410年8月攻破羅馬——從波倫提亞到洗劫羅馬只隔了八年，說明402年的勝利並未改變結構性困境。第三，制度層面上，這場戰爭確立了晚期羅馬與蠻族打交道的模式：以同盟、年金、劃地換取邊境安寧，再用羅馬的軍制與指揮去改造對方的軍隊。這套模式後來被汪達爾人、東哥特人、法蘭克人一再複製，決定了西歐政治的基本格局，也決定了羅馬城在五世紀初陷入的長期震動。
impactEn: The consequences reached far beyond the Italian battlefield. First, the campaign pushed back the storm from the west by eight years. The two defeats of 402 did not destroy Alaric; on the contrary they proved that Rome could not hold him permanently on the far side of the Adriatic. For years afterwards the western empire kept paying the annual pension, using the Goths as a screen — and that system of paying for one's own frontier defence was eventually turned against it by the very army it had raised. Second, Stilicho drew enormous prestige and booty from the victory: he was welcomed by the whole city in 403 and honoured with a statue in the Forum of Trajan, but his very success made him a target, and in 408 the emperor Honorius had him executed. The moment Stilicho died, the barbarian federate troops under him went over to Alaric, who was thereby able to enter Italy in 408 and again in 410, and finally broke into Rome in August 410. Only eight years separate Pollentia from the sack of the city, which shows that the victory of 402 had not altered the underlying structural difficulty. Third, at the level of institutions, the campaign fixed the pattern by which late Rome did business with the barbarians: substitute alliance, pension and allotted land for frontier peace, then remodel the other side's army in Roman drill and Roman command. The Vandals, the Ostrogoths and the Franks repeated that pattern again and again, and it fixed the basic political shape of the west, as well as the long disturbance into which the city of Rome fell in the early fifth century.
result: 結果是亞拉里克兩戰皆敗、卻全身而退。波倫提亞之戰他失去營盤與大量裝備，維羅納之戰損失慘重且大批人溺斃在阿迪杰河，退回伊利里亞時已不再是入境的優勢兵力；羅馬軍也未能全殲他，斯提里科在第二戰後立刻轉向議和，雙方在403年訂立和約：西哥特軍隊退出義大利，羅馬分期支付金錢，亞拉里克則以伊利里亞統治者的身分留居亞得里亞海東岸，與帝國維持可核對的和平。亞拉里克後來在405至406年羅馬對抗拉達蓋斯入侵時，居然以西哥特部隊的身分站在羅馬一方作戰，這說明他此時仍是可用的同盟者，而非必然的敵人。斯提里科則以征服者的姿態回到羅馬，獲得金屬戰利品的分配與紀念像，聲望達到頂點。真正的結局要到408年才攤開：攝政被殺，同盟軍倒戈，亞拉里克帶著這些裝備精良、熟悉羅馬軍制的部隊第三次進入義大利，兩年後攻陷羅馬。
resultEn: The result was that Alaric lost both battles yet withdrew whole. At Pollentia he lost his camp and a great deal of equipment; at Verona his losses were heavy and many were drowned in the Adige, and by the time he fell back into Illyria he was no longer the superior force that had entered Italy. Rome in turn could not annihilate him, and Stilicho turned at once to negotiation after the second battle: in 403 the two sides concluded a treaty, by which the Gothic troops withdrew from Italy, Rome paid the money in instalments, and Alaric stayed on the eastern shore of the Adriatic as ruler in Illyricum, keeping a peace that can be checked in the sources. When Rome fought Radagaisus's invasion in 405 and 406, Alaric actually fought on the Roman side with his Gothic troops, which shows that at that moment he was still a usable ally rather than an inevitable enemy. Stilicho returned to Rome in the posture of a conqueror, receiving a share of the metal booty and a commemorative statue, and his prestige reached its height. The real ending only unfolded in 408: the regent was killed, the allied troops went over, and Alaric entered Italy for the third time with troops well equipped and thoroughly drilled in Roman practice; two years later he was in Rome.
